steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: $2\sin x\cos x=2\sin x\Rightarrow2\sin x(\cos x-1)=0$；不能直接除以 $\sin x$。

exercises.prompt: 解释为什么第128题不能说明 $\sin2x=2\sin x$ 是恒等式。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 恒等式必须对共同定义域内所有值成立。第128题仅在 $x=0,\pi$ 成立；例如 $x=\pi/2$ 时左边为 0、右边为 2。

exercises.answer: 它是条件方程，不是恒等式。

en.prompt: Explain why Exercise 128 does not show that $\sin2x=2\sin x$ is an identity.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: An identity must hold at every point of the common domain. Exercise 128 holds only at $x=0,\pi$; at $x=\pi/2$, the left side is 0 and the right side is 2.

en.answer: It is a conditional equation, not an identity.
